companyRankingLists.itemDescription: Although best known for its ridesharing services, the technology company also offers food delivery, package delivery, and freight transportation in over 900 metropolitan areas worldwide. Uber dropped 53 spots in the Fortune 500 this year, as its revenue slid 21% in 2020 despite huge, pandemic-driven growth in its Uber Eats food delivery service. The company reported a $6.8 billion loss for 2020, but its stock delivered a 72% return for the year as investors bought into Uber's long-term growth potential.
